episodes.title: The Missing Name
episodes.premise: A beautiful presentation erases the person whose research made it possible. Recognition and a deadline collide.

episodes.title: The Empty Square
episodes.premise: A visually flawless installation cannot be used by a visitor. A public demonstration becomes a test of whose experience counts.

episodes.title: The Quiet Minute
episodes.premise: A confident team agrees too quickly. Its least-heard member is holding evidence that changes the plan.

episodes.title: Before the Doors Open
episodes.premise: The opening clock is running, and the team discovers an uncertainty they cannot honestly hide.
